episodes.title: The Rabbit Hole
episodes.summary: Growing Restless with married suburban life, New York therapist Jean Holloway develops a furtive fascination with a patient's ex-girlfriend.

episodes.title: Morgan Stop
episodes.summary: As "Diane" and Sidney get to know each other, longtime patient Claire grates on Jean's nerves, and new patient Allison slips into a downward spiral.

episodes.title: Driftwood Lane
episodes.summary: Jean surprises Michael with a date night in the city. Back in Connecticut, Dolly's birthday party creates new tensions with the power moms.
While Deepening her bond with Sidney, Jean uncovers the truth behind Rebecca's move and goes above and beyond to help a distressed Allison.

episodes.title: The Commune
episodes.summary: Michael grows suspicious of Jean's new secretive streak, Sidney's frustrations boil over, and a visit to Rebecca's new home triggers a revelation.

episodes.title: Vagabond Hotel
episodes.summary: After an intense night out with Michael, Jean finds her secret identity at risk once again. A surprise visitor adds to mounting pressures at work.

episodes.title: Euphoria
episodes.summary: While Michael and Alexis throw back drinks at a hotel bar in Texas, Jean clears her schedule to prepare for the "full Sidney experience".

episodes.title: Marfa
episodes.summary: The office rumor mill stirs up trouble for Michael. A request from Claire backs Jean into a corner. Sidney takes a defiant step.

episodes.title: Neverland
episodes.summary: Jean realizes a patient has been lying to her. As Dolly rehearses for her play, Jean contends with her disapproving mother and an impatient Sidney.

episodes.title: Black Barn
episodes.summary: Jean's worlds begin to collide as Sam celebrates his engagement, Michael makes a troubling discovery and a figure from the past reappears.
